# Tabs

Switch between views of one object (Overview, Configuration, Snapshots, Console, Logs).

`KenosUI.Tabs` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Tabs items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Tabs" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Tabs with arrow-key navigation; renders the active item's `content`.
